# pysmelly — findings register and review conventions

Run `make pysmelly` from the repo root. The recipe scans `.`, never `src/`:
pysmelly loads `[tool.pysmelly]` from the **target directory's**
`pyproject.toml` and does not walk upward, so a `src/` target runs
config-less with the `tests/` + `conftest.py` exclude silently disabled.
`bin/report` parses this same recipe for its pysmelly column, so the
report measures whatever the recipe names; `tests/test_pysmelly_target.py`
asserts every target it names carries a `[tool.pysmelly]` table. Full
guidance: https://github.com/borwickatuw/pysmelly#readme, or regenerate the
generic guide with `pysmelly init --short` — to a scratch path, since
everything below this paragraph is hand-maintained.

The target runs the source checks only. The history checks are a separate
command and nothing in `make check` reaches them:

```bash
pysmelly git-history --more-please    # stabilization, coupling, growth
```
